ko.tours.fileStorage.label: 파일 스토리지 생성·삭제
ko.tours.fileStorage.summary: CephFS 파일 스토리지를 만들고 목록에서 삭제하는 과정을 따라갑니다.
ko.tours.fileStorage.step1.title: 파일 스토리지 생성 열기
ko.tours.fileStorage.step1.description: + 파일 스토리지 생성 버튼을 눌러 생성 마법사를 엽니다.
ko.tours.fileStorage.step2.title: 이름·크기·프로토콜 입력
ko.tours.fileStorage.step2.description: 스토리지 이름을 입력하고 크기를 고른 뒤 프로토콜은 CephFS로 두고 '생성'을 누르세요.
ko.tours.fileStorage.step3.title: 생성 완료
ko.tours.fileStorage.step3.description: 스토리지가 준비되어 내보내기 위치가 표시됩니다. 접근 규칙은 나중에 추가할 수 있으니 '완료'를 눌러 마법사를 닫으세요.
ko.tours.fileStorage.step4.title: 새 스토리지 확인 후 삭제
ko.tours.fileStorage.step4.description: 목록에 방금 만든 스토리지가 추가됐습니다. 그 스토리지의 '삭제' 버튼을 누르세요. 확인 창이 열립니다.
ko.tours.fileStorage.step5.title: 삭제 확인
ko.tours.fileStorage.step5.description: 확인 창의 '확인'을 누르면 스토리지가 목록에서 제거됩니다.
ko.tours.fileStorage.step6.title: 삭제 완료
ko.tours.fileStorage.step6.description: 목록에서 방금 만든 스토리지가 사라졌는지 확인하세요. 다른 스토리지는 그대로 남습니다.
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.label: 볼륨 스냅샷 생성·삭제
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.summary: 볼륨 스냅샷을 만들고 목록에서 삭제하는 과정을 따라갑니다.
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.title: 스냅샷 생성 열기
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.description: + 스냅샷 생성 버튼을 눌러 생성 창을 엽니다.
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.title: 볼륨과 이름 입력
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.description: 사용 가능한 볼륨(튜토리얼에서는 scratch)을 고르고 스냅샷 이름을 입력한 뒤 '생성'을 누르세요. root-disk처럼 연결된 볼륨은 강제 스냅샷을 켜야 합니다.
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.title: 새 스냅샷 확인
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.title: 삭제 버튼 누르기
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.description: 방금 만든 스냅샷의 '삭제' 버튼을 누르세요. 확인 창이 열립니다.
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.title: 삭제 확인
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.description: 확인 창의 '확인'을 누르면 스냅샷이 목록에서 제거됩니다.
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.title: 삭제 완료
ko.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.description: 목록에서 방금 만든 스냅샷이 사라졌는지 확인하세요.

en.tours.fileStorage.label: Create·delete file storage
en.tours.fileStorage.summary: Create a CephFS file share and delete it from the list, step by step.
en.tours.fileStorage.step1.title: Open file storage creation
en.tours.fileStorage.step1.description: Click + Create file storage to open the creation wizard.
en.tours.fileStorage.step2.title: Enter name, size and protocol
en.tours.fileStorage.step2.description: Enter a share name, choose a size, keep the CephFS protocol, then click Create.
en.tours.fileStorage.step3.title: Share created
en.tours.fileStorage.step3.description: The share is ready and its export location is shown. Access rules can be added later; click Done to close the wizard.
en.tours.fileStorage.step4.title: Check the new share and delete it
en.tours.fileStorage.step4.description: The share you just created is now in the list. Click Delete on that share. A confirmation dialog opens.
en.tours.fileStorage.step5.title: Confirm deletion
en.tours.fileStorage.step5.description: Click Confirm in the confirmation dialog. The share is removed from the list.
en.tours.fileStorage.step6.title: Deletion complete
en.tours.fileStorage.step6.description: Check that the share you created is gone from the list. Other shares stay as they were.
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.label: Create·delete volume snapshots
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.summary: Create a snapshot of a volume and delete it from the list, step by step.
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.title: Open snapshot creation
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.description: Click + Create snapshot to open the creation dialog.
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.title: Choose a volume and name
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.description: Choose an available volume (in the tutorial, scratch), enter a snapshot name, then click Create. An attached volume such as root-disk needs force snapshot turned on.
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.title: Check the new snapshot
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.description: The snapshot you just created is now in the list.
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.title: Click Delete
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.description: Click Delete on the snapshot you just created. A confirmation dialog opens.
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.title: Confirm deletion
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.description: Click Confirm in the confirmation dialog. The snapshot is removed from the list.
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.title: Deletion complete
en.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.description: Check that the snapshot you created is gone from the list.

ja.tours.fileStorage.label: ファイルストレージの作成・削除
ja.tours.fileStorage.summary: CephFS ファイルストレージを作成し、一覧から削除するまでを順に案内します。
ja.tours.fileStorage.step1.title: ファイルストレージ作成を開く
ja.tours.fileStorage.step1.description: 「+ ファイルストレージを作成」を押して作成ウィザードを開きます。
ja.tours.fileStorage.step2.title: 名前・サイズ・プロトコルを入力
ja.tours.fileStorage.step2.description: ストレージ名を入力してサイズを選び、プロトコルは CephFS のまま「作成」を押してください。
ja.tours.fileStorage.step3.title: 作成完了
ja.tours.fileStorage.step3.description: ストレージの準備ができ、エクスポート先が表示されます。アクセスルールは後から追加できるので、「完了」を押してウィザードを閉じてください。
ja.tours.fileStorage.step4.title: 新しいストレージを確認して削除
ja.tours.fileStorage.step4.description: 作成したストレージが一覧に追加されました。そのストレージの「削除」を押すと確認ダイアログが開きます。
ja.tours.fileStorage.step5.title: 削除を確認
ja.tours.fileStorage.step5.description: 確認ダイアログの「確認」を押すと、ストレージは一覧から削除されます。
ja.tours.fileStorage.step6.title: 削除完了
ja.tours.fileStorage.step6.description: 作成したストレージが一覧から消えたことを確認してください。ほかのストレージはそのまま残ります。
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.label: ボリュームスナップショットの作成・削除
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.summary: ボリュームのスナップショットを作成し、一覧から削除するまでを順に案内します。
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.title: スナップショット作成を開く
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.description: 「+ スナップショットを作成」を押して作成ダイアログを開きます。
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.title: ボリュームと名前を入力
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.description: 利用可能なボリューム（チュートリアルでは scratch）を選び、スナップショット名を入力して「作成」を押してください。root-disk のように接続中のボリュームは強制スナップショットをオンにする必要があります。
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.title: 新しいスナップショットを確認
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.description: 作成したスナップショットが一覧に追加されました。
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.title: 削除を押す
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.description: 作成したスナップショットの「削除」を押すと確認ダイアログが開きます。
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.title: 削除を確認
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.description: 確認ダイアログの「確認」を押すと、スナップショットは一覧から削除されます。
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.title: 削除完了
ja.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.description: 作成したスナップショットが一覧から消えたことを確認してください。

zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.label: 创建·删除文件存储
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.summary: 按步骤创建一个 CephFS 文件存储，并将其从列表中删除。
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step1.title: 打开文件存储创建
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step1.description: 点击“+ 创建文件存储”打开创建向导。
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step2.title: 输入名称、大小和协议
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step2.description: 输入存储名称并选择大小，协议保持 CephFS，然后点击“创建”。
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step3.title: 创建完成
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step3.description: 存储已就绪并显示导出位置。访问规则可以稍后添加，点击“完成”关闭向导。
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step4.title: 确认新存储并删除
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step4.description: 刚创建的存储已出现在列表中。点击该存储的“删除”，将打开确认对话框。
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step5.title: 确认删除
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step5.description: 点击确认对话框中的“确认”，存储将从列表中移除。
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step6.title: 删除完成
zh-CN.tours.fileStorage.step6.description: 确认刚创建的存储已从列表中消失，其他存储保持不变。
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.label: 创建·删除卷快照
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.summary: 按步骤为卷创建快照，并将其从列表中删除。
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.title: 打开快照创建
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.description: 点击“+ 创建快照”打开创建对话框。
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.title: 选择卷并输入名称
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.description: 选择一个可用的卷（教程中为 scratch），输入快照名称，然后点击“创建”。像 root-disk 这样已挂载的卷需要开启强制快照。
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.title: 查看新快照
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.description: 刚创建的快照已出现在列表中。
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.title: 点击删除
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.description: 点击刚创建快照的“删除”，将打开确认对话框。
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.title: 确认删除
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.description: 点击确认对话框中的“确认”，快照将从列表中移除。
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.title: 删除完成
zh-CN.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.description: 确认刚创建的快照已从列表中消失。

bn.tours.fileStorage.label: ফাইল স্টোরেজ তৈরি·মুছে ফেলা
bn.tours.fileStorage.summary: একটি CephFS ফাইল স্টোরেজ তৈরি করে তালিকা থেকে মুছে ফেলার ধাপগুলো অনুসরণ করুন।
bn.tours.fileStorage.step1.title: ফাইল স্টোরেজ তৈরি খুলুন
bn.tours.fileStorage.step1.description: তৈরির উইজার্ড খুলতে "+ ফাইল স্টোরেজ তৈরি করুন" চাপুন।
bn.tours.fileStorage.step2.title: নাম, আকার ও প্রোটোকল দিন
bn.tours.fileStorage.step2.description: স্টোরেজের নাম লিখুন, আকার বেছে নিন, প্রোটোকল CephFS রেখে "তৈরি করুন" চাপুন।
bn.tours.fileStorage.step3.title: তৈরি সম্পন্ন
bn.tours.fileStorage.step3.description: স্টোরেজ প্রস্তুত এবং এর এক্সপোর্ট অবস্থান দেখানো হচ্ছে। অ্যাক্সেস নিয়ম পরে যোগ করা যায়; উইজার্ড বন্ধ করতে "সম্পন্ন" চাপুন।
bn.tours.fileStorage.step4.title: নতুন স্টোরেজ দেখে মুছুন
bn.tours.fileStorage.step4.description: আপনার তৈরি করা স্টোরেজটি তালিকায় যোগ হয়েছে। সেই স্টোরেজের "মুছুন" চাপুন। একটি নিশ্চিতকরণ ডায়ালগ খুলবে।
bn.tours.fileStorage.step5.title: মুছে ফেলা নিশ্চিত করুন
bn.tours.fileStorage.step5.description: নিশ্চিতকরণ ডায়ালগে "নিশ্চিত করুন" চাপলে স্টোরেজটি তালিকা থেকে সরে যাবে।
bn.tours.fileStorage.step6.title: মুছে ফেলা সম্পন্ন
bn.tours.fileStorage.step6.description: আপনার তৈরি করা স্টোরেজটি তালিকা থেকে সরে গেছে কি না দেখুন। অন্য স্টোরেজগুলো যেমন ছিল তেমনই থাকবে।
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.label: ভলিউম স্ন্যাপশট তৈরি·মুছে ফেলা
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.summary: একটি ভলিউমের স্ন্যাপশট তৈরি করে তালিকা থেকে মুছে ফেলার ধাপগুলো অনুসরণ করুন।
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.title: স্ন্যাপশট তৈরি খুলুন
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.description: তৈরির ডায়ালগ খুলতে "+ স্ন্যাপশট তৈরি করুন" চাপুন।
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.title: ভলিউম ও নাম বেছে নিন
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.description: একটি উপলব্ধ ভলিউম (টিউটোরিয়ালে scratch) বেছে নিন, স্ন্যাপশটের নাম লিখুন, তারপর "তৈরি করুন" চাপুন। root-disk-এর মতো সংযুক্ত ভলিউমের জন্য জোরপূর্বক স্ন্যাপশট চালু করতে হয়।
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.title: নতুন স্ন্যাপশট দেখুন
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.description: আপনার তৈরি করা স্ন্যাপশটটি এখন তালিকায় আছে।
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.title: মুছুন চাপুন
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.description: আপনার তৈরি করা স্ন্যাপশটের "মুছুন" চাপুন। একটি নিশ্চিতকরণ ডায়ালগ খুলবে।
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.title: মুছে ফেলা নিশ্চিত করুন
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.description: নিশ্চিতকরণ ডায়ালগে "নিশ্চিত করুন" চাপলে স্ন্যাপশটটি তালিকা থেকে সরে যাবে।
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.title: মুছে ফেলা সম্পন্ন
bn.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.description: আপনার তৈরি করা স্ন্যাপশটটি তালিকা থেকে সরে গেছে কি না দেখুন।

ms.tours.fileStorage.label: Cipta·padam storan fail
ms.tours.fileStorage.summary: Cipta storan fail CephFS dan padamkannya daripada senarai, langkah demi langkah.
ms.tours.fileStorage.step1.title: Buka penciptaan storan fail
ms.tours.fileStorage.step1.description: Klik + Cipta storan fail untuk membuka wizard penciptaan.
ms.tours.fileStorage.step2.title: Masukkan nama, saiz dan protokol
ms.tours.fileStorage.step2.description: Masukkan nama storan, pilih saiz, kekalkan protokol CephFS, kemudian klik Cipta.
ms.tours.fileStorage.step3.title: Storan dicipta
ms.tours.fileStorage.step3.description: Storan sudah sedia dan lokasi eksportnya dipaparkan. Peraturan akses boleh ditambah kemudian; klik Selesai untuk menutup wizard.
ms.tours.fileStorage.step4.title: Semak storan baharu dan padamkannya
ms.tours.fileStorage.step4.description: Storan yang baru anda cipta kini ada dalam senarai. Klik Padam pada storan itu. Dialog pengesahan akan dibuka.
ms.tours.fileStorage.step5.title: Sahkan pemadaman
ms.tours.fileStorage.step5.description: Klik Sahkan dalam dialog pengesahan. Storan akan dikeluarkan daripada senarai.
ms.tours.fileStorage.step6.title: Pemadaman selesai
ms.tours.fileStorage.step6.description: Semak bahawa storan yang anda cipta sudah tiada dalam senarai. Storan lain kekal seperti sedia ada.
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.label: Cipta·padam petikan volum
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.summary: Cipta petikan bagi volum dan padamkannya daripada senarai, langkah demi langkah.
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.title: Buka penciptaan petikan
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.description: Klik + Cipta petikan untuk membuka dialog penciptaan.
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.title: Pilih volum dan nama
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.description: Pilih volum yang tersedia (dalam tutorial, scratch), masukkan nama petikan, kemudian klik Cipta. Volum yang dilampirkan seperti root-disk memerlukan petikan paksa dihidupkan.
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.title: Semak petikan baharu
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.description: Petikan yang baru anda cipta kini ada dalam senarai.
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.title: Klik Padam
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.description: Klik Padam pada petikan yang baru anda cipta. Dialog pengesahan akan dibuka.
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.title: Sahkan pemadaman
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.description: Klik Sahkan dalam dialog pengesahan. Petikan akan dikeluarkan daripada senarai.
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.title: Pemadaman selesai
ms.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.description: Semak bahawa petikan yang anda cipta sudah tiada dalam senarai.

nb.tours.fileStorage.label: Opprett·slett fillagring
nb.tours.fileStorage.summary: Opprett en CephFS-fillagring og slett den fra listen, steg for steg.
nb.tours.fileStorage.step1.title: Åpne oppretting av fillagring
nb.tours.fileStorage.step1.description: Klikk + Opprett fillagring for å åpne opprettingsveiviseren.
nb.tours.fileStorage.step2.title: Angi navn, størrelse og protokoll
nb.tours.fileStorage.step2.description: Skriv inn et navn på lagringen, velg størrelse, behold protokollen CephFS og klikk Opprett.
nb.tours.fileStorage.step3.title: Lagringen er opprettet
nb.tours.fileStorage.step3.description: Lagringen er klar, og eksportplasseringen vises. Tilgangsregler kan legges til senere; klikk Ferdig for å lukke veiviseren.
nb.tours.fileStorage.step4.title: Sjekk den nye lagringen og slett den
nb.tours.fileStorage.step4.description: Lagringen du nettopp opprettet, står nå i listen. Klikk Slett på den lagringen. En bekreftelsesdialog åpnes.
nb.tours.fileStorage.step5.title: Bekreft sletting
nb.tours.fileStorage.step5.description: Klikk Bekreft i bekreftelsesdialogen. Lagringen fjernes fra listen.
nb.tours.fileStorage.step6.title: Slettingen er fullført
nb.tours.fileStorage.step6.description: Sjekk at lagringen du opprettet, er borte fra listen. Andre lagringer blir stående som før.
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.label: Opprett·slett øyeblikksbilder av volum
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.summary: Opprett et øyeblikksbilde av et volum og slett det fra listen, steg for steg.
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.title: Åpne oppretting av øyeblikksbilde
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.description: Klikk + Opprett øyeblikksbilde for å åpne opprettingsdialogen.
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.title: Velg volum og navn
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.description: Velg et tilgjengelig volum (scratch i opplæringen), skriv inn et navn på øyeblikksbildet og klikk Opprett. Et tilkoblet volum som root-disk krever at tvunget øyeblikksbilde er slått på.
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.title: Sjekk det nye øyeblikksbildet
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.description: Øyeblikksbildet du nettopp opprettet, står nå i listen.
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.title: Klikk Slett
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.description: Klikk Slett på øyeblikksbildet du nettopp opprettet. En bekreftelsesdialog åpnes.
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.title: Bekreft sletting
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.description: Klikk Bekreft i bekreftelsesdialogen. Øyeblikksbildet fjernes fra listen.
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.title: Slettingen er fullført
nb.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.description: Sjekk at øyeblikksbildet du opprettet, er borte fra listen.

sw.tours.fileStorage.label: Unda·futa hifadhi ya faili
sw.tours.fileStorage.summary: Unda hifadhi ya faili ya CephFS kisha uifute kwenye orodha, hatua kwa hatua.
sw.tours.fileStorage.step1.title: Fungua uundaji wa hifadhi ya faili
sw.tours.fileStorage.step1.description: Bofya + Unda hifadhi ya faili ili kufungua mchawi wa uundaji.
sw.tours.fileStorage.step2.title: Weka jina, ukubwa na itifaki
sw.tours.fileStorage.step2.description: Andika jina la hifadhi, chagua ukubwa, acha itifaki kuwa CephFS, kisha bofya Unda.
sw.tours.fileStorage.step3.title: Hifadhi imeundwa
sw.tours.fileStorage.step3.description: Hifadhi iko tayari na eneo lake la kusafirisha linaonyeshwa. Sheria za ufikiaji zinaweza kuongezwa baadaye; bofya Maliza ili kufunga mchawi.
sw.tours.fileStorage.step4.title: Kagua hifadhi mpya kisha uifute
sw.tours.fileStorage.step4.description: Hifadhi uliyounda sasa iko kwenye orodha. Bofya Futa kwenye hifadhi hiyo. Kidirisha cha uthibitisho kitafunguka.
sw.tours.fileStorage.step5.title: Thibitisha ufutaji
sw.tours.fileStorage.step5.description: Bofya Thibitisha kwenye kidirisha cha uthibitisho. Hifadhi itaondolewa kwenye orodha.
sw.tours.fileStorage.step6.title: Ufutaji umekamilika
sw.tours.fileStorage.step6.description: Hakikisha hifadhi uliyounda haipo tena kwenye orodha. Hifadhi nyingine zinabaki kama zilivyo.
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.label: Unda·futa nakala za muda za volumu
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.summary: Unda nakala ya muda ya volumu kisha uifute kwenye orodha, hatua kwa hatua.
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.title: Fungua uundaji wa nakala ya muda
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.description: Bofya + Unda nakala ya muda ili kufungua kidirisha cha uundaji.
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.title: Chagua volumu na jina
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.description: Chagua volumu inayopatikana (kwenye mafunzo, scratch), andika jina la nakala ya muda, kisha bofya Unda. Volumu iliyoambatishwa kama root-disk inahitaji kuwasha nakala ya muda ya lazima.
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.title: Kagua nakala mpya ya muda
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.description: Nakala ya muda uliyounda sasa iko kwenye orodha.
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.title: Bofya Futa
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.description: Bofya Futa kwenye nakala ya muda uliyounda. Kidirisha cha uthibitisho kitafunguka.
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.title: Thibitisha ufutaji
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.description: Bofya Thibitisha kwenye kidirisha cha uthibitisho. Nakala ya muda itaondolewa kwenye orodha.
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.title: Ufutaji umekamilika
sw.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.description: Hakikisha nakala ya muda uliyounda haipo tena kwenye orodha.

vi.tours.fileStorage.label: Tạo·xóa lưu trữ tệp
vi.tours.fileStorage.summary: Tạo một lưu trữ tệp CephFS rồi xóa nó khỏi danh sách theo từng bước.
vi.tours.fileStorage.step1.title: Mở tạo lưu trữ tệp
vi.tours.fileStorage.step1.description: Nhấn + Tạo lưu trữ tệp để mở trình hướng dẫn tạo.
vi.tours.fileStorage.step2.title: Nhập tên, dung lượng và giao thức
vi.tours.fileStorage.step2.description: Nhập tên lưu trữ, chọn dung lượng, giữ giao thức CephFS rồi nhấn Tạo.
vi.tours.fileStorage.step3.title: Đã tạo lưu trữ
vi.tours.fileStorage.step3.description: Lưu trữ đã sẵn sàng và vị trí xuất được hiển thị. Có thể thêm quy tắc truy cập sau; nhấn Hoàn tất để đóng trình hướng dẫn.
vi.tours.fileStorage.step4.title: Kiểm tra lưu trữ mới và xóa
vi.tours.fileStorage.step4.description: Lưu trữ bạn vừa tạo đã có trong danh sách. Nhấn Xóa trên lưu trữ đó. Hộp thoại xác nhận sẽ mở ra.
vi.tours.fileStorage.step5.title: Xác nhận xóa
vi.tours.fileStorage.step5.description: Nhấn Xác nhận trong hộp thoại xác nhận. Lưu trữ sẽ bị gỡ khỏi danh sách.
vi.tours.fileStorage.step6.title: Đã xóa xong
vi.tours.fileStorage.step6.description: Kiểm tra rằng lưu trữ bạn tạo đã biến mất khỏi danh sách. Các lưu trữ khác vẫn giữ nguyên.
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.label: Tạo·xóa bản chụp nhanh ổ đĩa
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.summary: Tạo bản chụp nhanh của một ổ đĩa rồi xóa nó khỏi danh sách theo từng bước.
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.title: Mở tạo bản chụp nhanh
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step1.description: Nhấn + Tạo bản chụp nhanh để mở hộp thoại tạo.
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.title: Chọn ổ đĩa và tên
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step2.description: Chọn một ổ đĩa khả dụng (trong hướng dẫn là scratch), nhập tên bản chụp nhanh rồi nhấn Tạo. Ổ đĩa đang gắn như root-disk cần bật chụp nhanh cưỡng bức.
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.title: Kiểm tra bản chụp nhanh mới
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step3.description: Bản chụp nhanh bạn vừa tạo đã có trong danh sách.
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.title: Nhấn Xóa
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step4.description: Nhấn Xóa trên bản chụp nhanh bạn vừa tạo. Hộp thoại xác nhận sẽ mở ra.
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.title: Xác nhận xóa
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step5.description: Nhấn Xác nhận trong hộp thoại xác nhận. Bản chụp nhanh sẽ bị gỡ khỏi danh sách.
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.title: Đã xóa xong
vi.tours.volumeSnapshots.step6.description: Kiểm tra rằng bản chụp nhanh bạn tạo đã biến mất khỏi danh sách.

dispatch: const storageFiles = mockStorageFiles(method, pathname, body); if (storageFiles !== undefined) return storageFiles;
notes: Place the dispatch line in transport.ts jsonFixture immediately AFTER the existing mockStorageSecrets dispatch line (before `if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/v1/volumes') return state.volumes;`). It must precede the old `GET /api/v1/volume-snapshots` (returns []) and `GET /api/v1/file-storage` handlers.

After merge, remove the now-dead transport lines `if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/v1/volume-snapshots') return [];` and the whole `if (method === 'GET' && pathname === '/api/v1/file-storage') { return [{ id: 'mock-share-1', ... }]; }` block (state.fileShares carries the same demo-dataset share). Share networks/share snapshots/security services GETs stay in transport.

state.ts: merge VolumeSnapshot into the existing `import type { AdminVolume, ... } from '$lib/types/volume'` line (the storage-secrets merge already moved VolumeBackup there). Seeds use the existing PROJECT_ID and NOW constants in state.ts.

The mock owns: GET/POST /api/v1/file-storage, GET /api/v1/file-storage/types (one DHSS=False CephFS default type, so the wizard creates directly from its basic step: no share-network beta or DHSS path is needed), GET /api/v1/file-storage/quota, GET/DELETE /api/v1/file-storage/{id}, GET /api/v1/file-storage/{id}/access-rules (always []), GET/POST /api/v1/volume-snapshots, DELETE /api/v1/volume-snapshots/{id}.

Like the real APIs, duplicate share and snapshot names are accepted (Manila and Cinder do not enforce unique names). Invalid input mirrors the backend: 422 for name/size/protocol/share type, 422 for NFS without a usable share network, 413 over the share count or gigabytes quota, 404 for unknown ids, 400 for an in-use volume snapshot without force, 500 for deleting a busy share or a creating snapshot.

file-storage step 3 highlights the wizard frame on its access step ([data-tour="file-storage-created"]; the frame carries file-storage-create-form on the basic step) and advances on a click inside the Skip/Done action row ([data-tour="file-storage-create-actions"]). Both buttons call closeWizard, which hands the created share to the page, so step 4's delete anchor appears either way.

Shared/component files touched: lib/stores/fileStorageWizardStore.svelte.ts (FsWizardOptions.onCreated now receives the created FileStorage; existing `() => {}` callers stay type-compatible), FileStorageWizard.svelte (onCreated prop typed with the created share; frame anchor), FileStorageWizardStep1.svelte (submit anchor), FileStorageWizardStep3.svelte (Skip/Done action-row anchor), FileStorageCard.svelte (optional tourDelete prop, anchors both card and desktop delete controls), VolumeSnapshotCreateModal.svelte (form/submit anchors), VolumeSnapshotsTable.svelte (optional highlightId prop; anchor only when the highlighted snapshot is available or error, in both snippets).

Volume snapshots page: the volumeSnapshots beta gate is shown in tutorial mode via `page.data?.mockup?.active === true && isMockAuthActive()` (same check as secrets); no localStorage write; non-tutorial behavior unchanged. The file-storage page needed no beta override.

Real-session guards: file-storage delete anchor only on the created share once status is available or error (the real create replies after Manila reports available); volume-snapshots delete anchor only on the created snapshot once available or error (Cinder refuses deleting a creating snapshot; the page refreshes after create and every 15s, step 3 waits up to 120000 ms). The mock returns `creating` from snapshot POST and finishes it on the next list read.

The snapshot create dialog preselects the first volume (root-disk, in-use); step 2 copy tells the user to pick the available `scratch` volume (mock-volume-2). Submitting root-disk without force shows the 400 error in the dialog and the tour waits.
Not changed: transport's DELETE /api/v1/volumes/{id} still deletes a volume that has snapshots (Cinder would refuse); that handler is outside this area.
